scope: M51/M82 processed texture alternatives only, not a blanket judgment of all Stellarium assets

observations.observed: M51 m51-vasey.png and M82 m82-vasey.png credit Plover Hill Observatory and point to Peter Vasey's site. The bundle contains heterogeneous origins including DSS; its root description and alphaBlend do not establish per-asset commercial redistribution rights.

observations.access: Read in the actual in-app browser. web open auto-HTTPS failed and does not establish absence of terms.
observations.shortExactNotice: Note that all photographs are Copyright © Peter Vasey and must not be reproduced without permission

observations.observed: Graphics chapter contains a general GPLv2-or-later statement except named exceptions; section 4.23 names M51/M82 and Peter Vasey. No additional explicit source-photograph license grant was observed in that section. The observed CREDITS commit pin is not asserted to be the current repository HEAD.

decision: Do not copy or adopt these two processed texture candidates under the current no-individual-permission commercial route without resolving the specific public rights chain. Do not infer a source photograph grant from the program license. This is insufficient admission evidence, not a claim that no lawful route exists.
reassessment: A clear public specific grant covering the actual image, modification, commercial display and redistribution under the existing autonomous-code and attribution conditions.

photutilsReuse.observed: Sources bias background estimates; masks and mesh background estimation must be distinguished from missing coverage. Documentation supports use of the mature estimator, not physical accuracy for this prepared display photo.

limits: Primary live-page observations and pinned official text; no individual permission, legal certification, image-quality adoption, native validation or deployment. The already excluded DSS route remains excluded.
